// AUTOMATICALLY GENERATED: location from saved link.
Map.setCenter(113.36630859375089, -8.407746733358792, 6)

// 1. Tentukan area studi (koordinat atau poligon)
var areaStudi = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([110.3, -7.8, 110.5, -7.6]); // Contoh area di Yogyakarta

// 2. Ambil koleksi citra Landsat 8
var landsat8 = ee.ImageCollection("LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_TOA")
  .filterBounds(areaStudi) // Filter area studi
  .filterDate("2023-01-01", "2023-12-31") // Pilih rentang waktu
  .filter(ee.Filter.lt("CLOUD_COVER", 10)) // Filter citra dengan <10% awan
  .median(); // Gabungkan citra menjadi satu komposit

// 3. Visualisasi RGB (Band 4, 3, 2)
var visParams = {bands: ["B4", "B3", "B2"], min: 0, max: 0.3};
Map.centerObject(areaStudi, 10);
Map.addLayer(landsat8, visParams, "Landsat 8 True Color");

// 4. Ekspor citra ke Google Drive
Export.image.toDrive({
  image: landsat8,
  description: "Landsat8_Jakarta",
  scale: 30, // Resolusi spasial 30m
  region: areaStudi,
  fileFormat: "GeoTIFF",
  maxPixels: 1e13
});
